import re

 'thing': ('thing', 'Thing', 'thing_id: str'),
 'part': ('part', 'Part', 'part_id: str'),
 'batch': ('batch', 'Batch', 'batch_id: str'),
 'sample': ('sample', 'Sample', 'sample_id: str'),
 'report': ('report', 'Report', 'report_id: str'),
 'label': ('label', 'Label', 'label_id: str'),
}
for f,(noun,ent,params) in spec.items():
    p=f'{f}_repository.py'; s=open(p).read()

    lock = plain + '_for_update'
    m = re.search(r'    @abstractmethod\n    async def '+plain+r'\(.*?\n        \.\.\.\n', s, re.S)
    assert m, f
    block = m.group(0)
    method = f'''
    @abstractmethod
    async def {lock}(
        self, {params}
    ) -> {ent} | None:
        """Return a {noun} by primary key including deleted rows and lock its row.

        Only the delete path calls this; the row stays locked until the transaction ends.
        """
        ...
'''
    s = s.replace(block, block + method, 1)
    open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
